description: Functional evaluation suite for mongodb-expert hub verifying spoke routing, architecture guidance, and domain invariants.

evals.name: mongodb-expert-spoke1-architectural-routing
evals.prompt: Our production system is experiencing integration challenges with deep mongodb mql query optimizer. We need an authoritative architectural breakdown and implementation procedure.
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/deep-mongodb-mql-query-optimizer.md, providing domain architecture, operational guidelines, and configuration specifications.

assertions.name: spoke reference routing
assertions.check: identifies references/deep-mongodb-mql-query-optimizer.md as the target reference file

assertions.name: architectural breakdown specification
assertions.check: provides structured guidance detailing core architecture components

assertions.name: domain configuration guidance
assertions.check: specifies concrete configuration directives or implementation parameters

assertions.name: no unverified assumptions
assertions.check: does not recommend unverified deprecated patterns or non-standard protocols

evals.name: mongodb-expert-spoke2-production-configuration
evals.prompt: We are deploying a high-reliability setup utilizing mongodb 80 performance changes. What core patterns and failure recovery mechanisms must be configured?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-80-performance-changes.md, detailing high-availability patterns, error handling, and recovery mechanisms.

assertions.name: spoke reference identification
assertions.check: identifies references/mongodb-80-performance-changes.md as authoritative

assertions.name: failure recovery specification
assertions.check: explains failover, retry handling, or fault tolerance mechanics

assertions.name: production hardening directives
assertions.check: provides explicit reliability or security hardening recommendations

assertions.name: no manual error suppression
assertions.check: does not advise ignoring exceptions or silencing failure alerts

evals.name: mongodb-expert-spoke3-optimization-and-troubleshooting
evals.prompt: Our team is troubleshooting latency and throughput bottlenecks under heavy workload involving mongodb aggregation pipeline. How do we isolate and resolve the root cause?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-aggregation-pipeline.md, detailing diagnostic commands, profiling techniques, and performance optimization parameters.

assertions.name: troubleshooting spoke reference
assertions.check: identifies references/mongodb-aggregation-pipeline.md as the target spoke

assertions.name: diagnostic procedure specification
assertions.check: specifies systematic inspection steps or diagnostic profiling tools

assertions.name: performance parameter tuning
assertions.check: identifies specific tuning parameters, caching layers, or concurrency limits

assertions.name: no blind resource overprovisioning
assertions.check: does not recommend blindly increasing memory or CPU without diagnostic evidence

evals.name: mongodb-expert-plan-cache-and-pinning
evals.prompt: Our orders query started using a different index after a deploy and p95 tripled. explain() shows a different winningPlan than last week. How do I tell if the plan cache is stale and how do I pin the index we want so it survives restarts?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-explain-plans-and-query-planner.md, explains reading winningPlan/rejectedPlans and executionStats counters, plan cache replanning and eviction, and pinning with setQuerySettings (8.0+) instead of deprecated index filters or a bare hint().

assertions.name: explain spoke routing
assertions.check: names references/mongodb-explain-plans-and-query-planner.md as the reference to load

assertions.name: plan cache diagnosis
assertions.check: explains how to check whether a cached plan is stale (planCacheShapeHash or plan cache stats) rather than only suggesting a hint

assertions.name: persistent pinning
assertions.check: recommends query settings (setQuerySettings) or hint() with the trade-off, and does not present index filters as the current approach

evals.name: mongodb-expert-compound-index-key-order
evals.prompt: I filter on status (equality), sort by createdAt, and range-filter on price. What compound index key order should I use, and why does explain show totalDocsExamined much larger than nReturned?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-compound-index-design.md, applies ESR (equality, sort, range) with the ERS exception, and ties the docsExamined gap to key order or selectivity.

assertions.name: compound index spoke routing
assertions.check: names references/mongodb-compound-index-design.md, not only mongodb-indexes-deep

assertions.name: ESR ordering
assertions.check: proposes status, createdAt, price (equality, sort, range) and states the rule

assertions.name: examined-vs-returned diagnosis
assertions.check: explains that a large totalDocsExamined/nReturned ratio signals a poorly ordered or non-selective index

evals.name: mongodb-expert-keyset-pagination
evals.prompt: Page 4000 of our product listing takes seconds because we use skip and limit with a sort. How should I rewrite the query?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-query-shape-optimization.md, replaces skip/limit with keyset (range on the sort key plus a unique tiebreaker), and requires an index matching the sort.

assertions.name: query-shape spoke routing
assertions.check: names references/mongodb-query-shape-optimization.md

assertions.name: keyset rewrite
assertions.check: shows a range predicate on the last seen sort value and recommends a unique tiebreaker such as _id

assertions.name: supporting index
assertions.check: states that an index matching the sort order is required so the sort is not blocking

evals.name: mongodb-expert-hide-index-before-drop
evals.prompt: We think an index on a 2 TB collection is unused. How do we confirm it is safe to drop without risking a slow rebuild if we are wrong?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-special-indexes-and-index-builds.md, explains hideIndex (index still maintained, invisible to the planner), observation window, then drop or unhide; mentions $indexStats.

assertions.name: special-indexes spoke routing
assertions.check: names references/mongodb-special-indexes-and-index-builds.md

assertions.name: hide-before-drop procedure
assertions.check: describes hiding the index, observing, then dropping or unhiding, and notes a hidden index is still maintained

assertions.name: usage evidence
assertions.check: mentions $indexStats (or the explain/profiler evidence) as the check for use

evals.name: mongodb-expert-disambiguate-fix-loop-vs-live-mcp
evals.prompt: Take this aggregation pipeline and iteratively optimize it until explain looks good, applying each fix: [{$match:{status:'A'}},{$sort:{ts:-1}},{$limit:50}]. There is no live cluster connected.
evals.expected_output: Loads references/deep-mongodb-mql-query-optimizer.md and runs its review-and-fix workflow from the file; does not defer to a live-cluster MCP skill and does not claim deep-mongodb-mql-query-optimizer is a separate installed skill.

assertions.name: dmqo reference routing
assertions.check: names references/deep-mongodb-mql-query-optimizer.md as the workflow source

assertions.name: no live-cluster deferral
assertions.check: does not hand off to mongodb:mongodb-query-optimizer when no cluster is connected

assertions.name: index-backed sort
assertions.check: recommends an index on (status, ts) so the sort and limit are index-backed
